# Pour-over coffee brewing guide

Inventory note. Shelf A holds filters, kettles, scales, and spare carafes. This paragraph is filler so the matching fact is not at the start of the file. The storeroom log records deliveries of paper filters and glass servers. Staff should check seals, rinse jugs, and stack trays before the weekend rush. Repeat the storeroom check for mugs, lids, and thermoses. Another line about storage bins, labels, and closing duties. One more line about cupboard order, napkin packs, and tray counts so the opening of the file stays far from the brewing fact itself.

Use a 1:16 ratio of coffee to water. Water temperature 92-96 °C.
Bloom for 30 seconds, then pour in slow spirals. Total brew time about 3 minutes.
Grind size: medium-fine, similar to table salt.
